fullText.simplified:
第3章、甲虫高尔

    早上醒来，高尔发现自己的身体变成了甲虫的样子。
    “我变成了一只甲虫？！”高尔惊叫出声。但马上，他又被新的发现吓到了。他的手也不见了，他的腿和手都变成了甲虫的小腿。他说不出话了，他的惊叫声——听上去，完全不是人的声音，更像是虫子的叫声。
    他吓得大声喊叫，但没有用。他用尽了全部力气，都只能像甲虫一样发出“嗯嗯”的声音。
    “高尔，起床了！上班要迟到了！”这是爸爸的声音。爸爸已经起床了，他在门外叫高尔。
    “好的，我马上起床！”高尔想这样回答，但他的叫喊声像是听不太清楚的“嗯嗯”。爸爸听到了，然后走开了。
    我不能变成一只虫子！我要去工作，我需要这份工作！高尔急得想哭。他努力下床，但十分钟过去了，他只在床上爬动了一点儿。
    “高尔，你怎么还没起床？”这一次是妈妈的声音。
    高尔又大叫了几声，妈妈听到了。“你的声音怎么了？你病了吗？”妈妈问。
    啊！温柔的妈妈终于听出了不一样。
    “你把门打开，让我进去看看。”妈妈说。
    高尔一直在用力爬，但这时候他不敢动了。他看了看自己的身体，他害怕了。他不敢让妈妈看到他这个样子。
    “妈妈，你别叫了，哥哥等会儿就会起床的。”这是妹妹的声音。妹妹的房间在高尔的旁边。妹妹已经醒了，但她也还没起床，因为她是在自己的房间里对妈妈喊话的。
fullText.traditional:
第3章、甲蟲高爾

    早上醒來，高爾發現自己的身體變成了甲蟲的樣子。
    “我變成了一隻甲蟲？！”高爾驚叫出聲。但馬上，他又被新的發現嚇到了。他的手也不見了，他的腿和手都變成了甲蟲的小腿。他說不出話了，他的驚叫聲——聽上去，完全不是人的聲音，更像是蟲子的叫聲。
    他嚇得大聲喊叫，但沒有用。他用盡了全部力氣，都只能像甲蟲一樣發出“嗯嗯”的聲音。
    “高爾，起床了！上班要遲到了！”這是爸爸的聲音。爸爸已經起床了，他在門外叫高爾。
    “好的，我馬上起床！”高爾想這樣回答，但他的叫喊聲像是聽不太清楚的“嗯嗯”。爸爸聽到了，然後走開了。
    我不能變成一隻蟲子！我要去工作，我需要這份工作！高爾急得想哭。他努力下床，但十分鐘過去了，他只在床上爬動了一點兒。
    “高爾，你怎麼還沒起床？”這一次是媽媽的聲音。
    高爾又大叫了幾聲，媽媽聽到了。“你的聲音怎麼了？你病了嗎？”媽媽問。
    啊！溫柔的媽媽終於聽出了不一樣。
    “你把門打開，讓我進去看看。”媽媽說。
    高爾一直在用力爬，但這時候他不敢動了。他看了看自己的身體，他害怕了。他不敢讓媽媽看到他這個樣子。
    “媽媽，你別叫了，哥哥等會兒就會起床的。”這是妹妹的聲音。妹妹的房間在高爾的旁邊。妹妹已經醒了，但她也還沒起床，因為她是在自己的房間裡對媽媽喊話的。

sentences.simplified: 早上醒来，高尔发现自己的身体变成了甲虫的样子。
sentences.traditional: 早上醒來，高爾發現自己的身體變成了甲蟲的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo shang xǐng lái gāo ěr fā xiàn zì jǐ de shēn tǐ biàn chéng le jiǎ chóng de yàng zi
sentences.english: When he woke up in the morning, Gao Er found that his body had turned into a beetle.

sentences.simplified: “我变成了一只甲虫？！”高尔惊叫出声。
sentences.traditional: “我變成了一隻甲蟲？！”高爾驚叫出聲。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ biàn chéng le yì zhī jiǎ chóng gāo ěr jīng jiào chū shēng
sentences.english: “I’ve turned into a beetle?!” Gao Er screamed out loud.

sentences.simplified: 但马上，他又被新的发现吓到了。他的手也不见了，
sentences.traditional: 但馬上，他又被新的發現嚇到了。他的手也不見了，
sentences.pinyin: dàn mǎ shàng tā yòu bèi xīn de fā xiàn xià dào le tā de shǒu yě bú jiàn le
sentences.english: But immediately, he was frightened by a new discovery. His hands had also disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 他的腿和手都变成了甲虫的小腿。
sentences.traditional: 他的腿和手都變成了甲蟲的小腿。
sentences.pinyin: tā de tuǐ hé shǒu dōu biàn chéng le jiǎ chóng de xiǎo tuǐ
sentences.english: His legs and hands had turned into the small legs of a beetle.

sentences.simplified: 他说不出话了，他的惊叫声——听上去，完全不是人的声音，更像是虫子的叫声。
sentences.traditional: 他說不出話了，他的驚叫聲——聽上去，完全不是人的聲音，更像是蟲子的叫聲。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō bù chū huà le tā de jīng jiào shēng tīng shàng qu wán quán bú shì rén de shēng yīn gèng xiàng shì chóng zi de jiào shēng
sentences.english: He couldn’t speak. His screams—sounded nothing like a human’s but more like the cries of an insect.

sentences.simplified: 他吓得大声喊叫，但没有用。他用尽了全部力气，都只能像甲虫一样发出“嗯嗯”的声音。
sentences.traditional: 他嚇得大聲喊叫，但沒有用。他用盡了全部力氣，都只能像甲蟲一樣發出“嗯嗯”的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: tā xià de dà shēng hǎn jiào dàn méi yǒu yòng tā yòng jìn le quán bù lì qi dōu zhǐ néng xiàng jiǎ chóng yí yàng fā chū ēn ēn de shēng yīn
sentences.english: He screamed in fear, but it was of no use. He used all his strength but could only make a “hmm hmm” sound like a beetle.

sentences.simplified: “高尔，起床了！上班要迟到了！”这是爸爸的声音。
sentences.traditional: “高爾，起床了！上班要遲到了！”這是爸爸的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr qǐ chuáng le shàng bān yào chí dào le zhè shì bà ba de shēng yīn
sentences.english: “Gao Er, get up! You’re going to be late for work!” This was his father’s voice.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸已经起床了，他在门外叫高尔。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸已經起床了，他在門外叫高爾。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba yǐ jīng qǐ chuáng le tā zài mén wài jiào gāo ěr
sentences.english: His father had already gotten up. He was outside the door calling Gao Er.

sentences.simplified: “好的，我马上起床！”高尔想这样回答，但他的叫喊声像是听不太清楚的“嗯嗯”。
sentences.traditional: “好的，我馬上起床！”高爾想這樣回答，但他的叫喊聲像是聽不太清楚的“嗯嗯”。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo de wǒ mǎ shàng qǐ chuáng gāo ěr xiǎng zhè yàng huí dá dàn tā de jiào hǎn shēng xiàng shì tīng bú tài qīng chu de ēn ēn
sentences.english: “Okay, I’m getting up right away!” Gao Er wanted to respond in this way, but his shouting sounded like indistinct “hmm hmm”.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸听到了，然后走开了。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸聽到了，然後走開了。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba tīng dào le rán hòu zǒu kāi le
sentences.english: His father heard him, and then walked away.

sentences.simplified: 我不能变成一只虫子！我要去工作，我需要这份工作！高尔急得想哭。
sentences.traditional: 我不能變成一隻蟲子！我要去工作，我需要這份工作！高爾急得想哭。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù néng biàn chéng yì zhī chóng zi wǒ yào qù gōng zuò wǒ xū yào zhè fèn gōng zuò gāo ěr jí de xiǎng kū
sentences.english: I can’t turn into an insect! I need to go to work. I need this job! Gao Er was so anxious that he wanted to cry.

sentences.simplified: 他努力下床，但十分钟过去了，他只在床上爬动了一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 他努力下床，但十分鐘過去了，他只在床上爬動了一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: tā nǔ lì xià chuáng dàn shí fēn zhōng guò qù le tā zhǐ zài chuáng shang pá dòng le yì diǎn'r
sentences.english: He struggled to get out of bed, but ten minutes passed, and he had only moved a little on the bed.

sentences.simplified: “高尔，你怎么还没起床？”这一次是妈妈的声音。
sentences.traditional: “高爾，你怎麼還沒起床？”這一次是媽媽的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr nǐ zěn me hái méi qǐ chuáng zhè yí cì shì mā ma de shēng yīn
sentences.english: “Gao Er, why haven’t you gotten up yet?” This time, it was his mother’s voice.

sentences.simplified: 高尔又大叫了几声，妈妈听到了。
sentences.traditional: 高爾又大叫了幾聲，媽媽聽到了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr yòu dà jiào le jǐ shēng mā ma tīng dào le
sentences.english: Gao Er yelled a few more times, and his mother heard him.

sentences.simplified: “你的声音怎么了？你病了吗？”妈妈问。
sentences.traditional: “你的聲音怎麼了？你病了嗎？”媽媽問。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ de shēng yīn zěn me le nǐ bìng le ma mā ma wèn
sentences.english: “What happened to your voice? Are you sick?” his mother asked.

sentences.simplified: 啊！温柔的妈妈终于听出了不一样。
sentences.traditional: 啊！溫柔的媽媽終於聽出了不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: a wēn róu de mā ma zhōng yú tīng chū le bù yí yàng
sentences.english: Ah! His gentle mother finally noticed something was different.

sentences.simplified: “你把门打开，让我进去看看。”妈妈说。
sentences.traditional: “你把門打開，讓我進去看看。”媽媽說。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bǎ mén dǎ kāi ràng wǒ jìn qù kàn kan mā ma shuō
sentences.english: “Open the door and let me in to take a look,” his mother said.

sentences.simplified: 高尔一直在用力爬，但这时候他不敢动了。
sentences.traditional: 高爾一直在用力爬，但這時候他不敢動了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr yì zhí zài yòng lì pá dàn zhè shí hou tā bù gǎn dòng le
sentences.english: Gao Er had been crawling with much effort, but at this moment, he did not dare move.

sentences.simplified: 他看了看自己的身体，他害怕了。他不敢让妈妈看到他这个样子。
sentences.traditional: 他看了看自己的身體，他害怕了。他不敢讓媽媽看到他這個樣子。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le kàn zì jǐ de shēn tǐ tā hài pà le tā bù gǎn ràng mā ma kàn dào tā zhè ge yàng zi
sentences.english: He looked at his own body and was scared. He was afraid to let his mother see him in this state.

sentences.simplified: “妈妈，你别叫了，哥哥等会儿就会起床的。”这是妹妹的声音。
sentences.traditional: “媽媽，你別叫了，哥哥等會兒就會起床的。”這是妹妹的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma nǐ bié jiào le gē ge děng huì'r jiù huì qǐ chuáng de zhè shì mèi mei de shēng yīn
sentences.english: “Mom, stop yelling. Older brother will get up in a little while.” This was his little sister’s voice.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹的房间在高尔的旁边。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹的房間在高爾的旁邊。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei de fáng jiān zài gāo ěr de páng biān
sentences.english: Gao Er’s little sister’s room was next to his.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹已经醒了，但她也还没起床，因为她是在自己的房间里对妈妈喊话的。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹已經醒了，但她也還沒起床，因為她是在自己的房間裡對媽媽喊話的。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei yǐ jīng xǐng le dàn tā yě hái méi qǐ chuáng yīn wèi tā shì zài zì jǐ de fáng jiān lǐ duì mā ma hǎn huà de
sentences.english: His little sister was already awake, but she hadn’t gotten out of bed yet, because she was calling out to their mother from her own room.

sentence_translations: Chapter 3: The Beetle Gao Er
When he woke up in the morning, Gao Er found that his body had turned into a beetle.
“I’ve turned into a beetle?!” Gao Er screamed out loud.
But immediately, he was frightened by a new discovery. His hands had also disappeared.
His legs and hands had turned into the small legs of a beetle.
He couldn’t speak. His screams—sounded nothing like a human’s but more like the cries of an insect.
He screamed in fear, but it was of no use. He used all his strength but could only make a “hmm hmm” sound like a beetle.
“Gao Er, get up! You’re going to be late for work!” This was his father’s voice.
His father had already gotten up. He was outside the door calling Gao Er.
“Okay, I’m getting up right away!” Gao Er wanted to respond in this way, but his shouting sounded like indistinct “hmm hmm”.
His father heard him, and then walked away.
I can’t turn into an insect! I need to go to work. I need this job! Gao Er was so anxious that he wanted to cry.
He struggled to get out of bed, but ten minutes passed, and he had only moved a little on the bed.
“Gao Er, why haven’t you gotten up yet?” This time, it was his mother’s voice.
Gao Er yelled a few more times, and his mother heard him.
“What happened to your voice? Are you sick?” his mother asked.
Ah! His gentle mother finally noticed something was different.
“Open the door and let me in to take a look,” his mother said.
Gao Er had been crawling with much effort, but at this moment, he did not dare move.
He looked at his own body and was scared. He was afraid to let his mother see him in this state.
“Mom, stop yelling. Older brother will get up in a little while.” This was his little sister’s voice.
Gao Er’s little sister’s room was next to his.
His little sister was already awake, but she hadn’t gotten out of bed yet, because she was calling out to their mother from her own room.
